title: Toehold Testing in PURE System for Protein Production
author: Junyan Qian

steps.title: Prepare 384-well microplate
steps.instruction: Prepare a clean 384-well microplate by marking the wells to be used on the plastic cover; place the cover underneath the plate after marking to visualize the wells and prevent pipetting errors.

steps.title: Prepare OnePot premix
steps.instruction: Prepare a premix of OnePot protein solution and OnePot ribosome solution at a ratio of 13:18. For a 5 µL reaction, 1.5 µL of premix is required.

substeps.instruction: Calculate volumes for the required number of reactions (e.g., for 5 reactions, use 4.64 µL OnePot protein solution and 6.43 µL OnePot ribosome solution).
Prepare one extra reaction volume to ensure sufficient premix solution.

steps.title: Prepare toehold and trigger solutions
steps.instruction: Dilute or concentrate the toehold switch and trigger dsDNA to the desired concentrations before adding to the reaction to fit within the remaining 1.5 µL space.

substeps.instruction: Example concentrations: 5 nanomolar (nM) for toehold switch and 2 micromolar (µM) for trigger dsDNA.

steps.title: Seal and measure samples
steps.instruction: Seal the wells and initiate measurement in the plate reader.

substeps.instruction: Add 35 µL of BIO-RAD Chillout liquid wax to each well.
Place the plate gently inside the plate reader.
Verify plate reader settings and start the measurement.
